build_tree_predictor: build a TreePredictor instance from nodes and categorical bitset arrays for gradient boosting predictions
predict_raw_data: predict raw values for non-binned input data using the TreePredictor predict method with categorical bitsets
predict_binned_data: predict raw values for pre-binned input data using the TreePredictor predict_binned method
compute_partial_dependence: compute partial dependence values for a grid of feature values using the TreePredictor compute_partial_dependence method
get_tree_statistics: get tree statistics such as number of leaf nodes and maximum depth from a TreePredictor instance
